# Three.js

Three.js **0.180.0**, distributed locally so the arena does not require a CDN at runtime.

- `three.module.min.js` and `three.core.min.js`: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.180.0/build/
- License: MIT, included in `LICENSE`.
- Official installation reference: https://threejs.org/manual/en/installation.html

Keep both JavaScript files on the same version when updating.
